tools.name: formspec_wireframes_add_action
tools.title: Add app action
tools.description: Add a full Response Actions action for navigation triggers or widget outputs. A Definition must be declared first.

id.description: Stable action id used by Surface transition triggers.

intent.description: Closed-core intent or x-* extension intent. An x-* intent requires an explicit validation tuple and a matching Registry contribution; prefer a closed-core intent for local navigation actions.

validation.description: Required when intent starts with x-.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_add_experience_actor
tools.title: Add Experience actor
tools.description: Add a person or role to the active Experience before tasks or units cite it.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_add_experience_task
tools.title: Add Experience task
tools.description: Add a task to the active Experience. Any actor_refs must already exist.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_add_experience_unit
tools.title: Add Experience unit
tools.description: Add an Experience unit after any cited actors and tasks exist. item_refs and action_refs connect rendered features to this unit.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_add_route
tools.title: Add route or view
tools.description: Add an arbitrary route/view to the active app Surface.

scope.description: Navigation context shown while this route is active. Routes with omitted scope use the default context.

navigation.description: Structured route-navigation chrome. Strict validation rejects implicit visible navigation; provide a traced label or set visible=false.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_add_transition
tools.title: Add route transition
tools.description: Connect two routes with a trigger, optional FEL condition, and optional route parameters.

trigger.description: Response Action id or closed-core intent. Declare the matching Action first: an id matches action.id, while an intent must resolve to exactly one Action.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_adopt_need
tools.title: Adopt Need
tools.description: Adopt a proposed Need. The server-side acting actor must satisfy the human adoption rule for AI-proposed Needs.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_bind_slot
tools.title: Bind route content
tools.description: Bind one of the five Surface slot types: Definition form, Experience unit, module widget, static content, or embedded route.

experienceRef.description: External Experience document URL. Omit for a bundle-local unit added in this session.

sourceRef.description: Data Sources 1.0 source id resolved within catalogRef.

x-generation.description: Direct Need trace for this named rendered data binding.
Direct Need trace for this named rendered action binding.
Direct Need trace for the rendered static content; the enclosing slot trace does not cover it.

binding.description: Binding object matching the selected slot_type.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_cite_need
tools.title: Cite Need from Experience
tools.description: Bind an Experience unit to a Need it serves. Both ids must already exist in the paired authoring state.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_edit_definition
tools.title: Author Definition
tools.description: Declare any bundle-local Definition, then add fields or behaviors to that exact definition_url.

widgetHint.description: StudioCore built-in widget name. Use TextInput for both short and multi-line text fields.

x-generation.description: Required for operation=declare, add_field, and set_behavior so the rendered Definition title, field, or behavior directly traces to an adopted Need revision.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_edit_registry
tools.title: Author module Registry
tools.description: Declare the bundle-local Registry, then add modules, widgets, or an exact advanced Registry entry.

version.description: Registry version for declare, or exact widget version for add_widget.

entry.description: Required for operation=add_entry. Exact RegistryEntry object.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_export
tools.title: Export app bundle
tools.description: Return the exact public BundleExport or its aggregate publishability refusal.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_materialize_data_sources
tools.title: Materialize Data Sources
tools.description: Create and declare a bundle-local Data Sources catalog for data-bound widgets and views.

x-formspec-runtime.description: Generic host resolver metadata. It declares where source data comes from without embedding product-specific loading code in the renderer.

x-generation.description: Direct Need trace for this rendered data source.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_materialize_definition
tools.title: Materialize exact Definition
tools.description: Install a complete structured Definition document at its exact URL. Use this for nested groups and other schema features beyond incremental field editing.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_materialize_response_actions
tools.title: Materialize Response Actions
tools.description: Install one complete response-scoped or app-scoped Response Actions document at its exact bundle-local URL, including typed browser and service effects.

url.description: Canonical bundle-local URL for this Response Actions document.

id.description: Stable action id used by Surface transition triggers.

intent.description: Closed-core intent or x-* extension intent. An x-* intent requires an explicit validation tuple and a matching Registry contribution; prefer a closed-core intent for local navigation actions.

validation.description: Required when intent starts with x-.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_pair_needs
tools.title: Pair Needs document
tools.description: Explicitly pair a Needs Document with this authoring session. Pairing is caller-owned and never inferred from file location.

version.description: Needs Document version. SemVer is recommended by the Needs specification but not required.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_preview
tools.title: Preview app wireframe
tools.description: Return the current App Manifest and Surface authoring draft, including incomplete-route diagnostics.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_propose_need
tools.title: Propose Need
tools.description: Add an evidence-grounded or explicitly ungrounded Need. Origin and proposedBy come from the server-side acting actor.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_read_needs
tools.title: Read paired Needs
tools.description: Read the caller-paired Needs Document with lifecycle and evidence fields intact.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_read_reasoning_review
tools.title: Read reasoning review
tools.description: Review Needs, Experience citations, mounted routes, rendered-node traces, coverage gaps, and unresolved references in one structured result.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_read_summary
tools.title: Read authoring summary
tools.description: Read app, routes, slots, authored resources, draft diagnostics, and the latest validation counts.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_report_capability_gap
tools.title: Report capability gap
tools.description: Record a structured authoring capability gap. Every open gap remains visible and blocks validation and export.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_resolve_capability_gap
tools.title: Resolve capability gap
tools.description: Close a previously reported capability gap with an explicit resolution and notes.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_start_app
tools.title: Start app wireframe
tools.description: Start one general app and its initial Surface. The session owns this app until export.

surface_url.description: Canonical URL of the app Surface to author.

x-generation.description: Need trace applied to both the App Manifest title and Surface-level rendered chrome.

tools.name: formspec_wireframes_validate
tools.title: Validate app wireframe
tools.description: Run schema and AppGraph validation with construction-injected validators.

statement.want: to create a managed form and return to its draft
statement.why: form work must remain usable without editing raw JSON
statement.done: the owner can create, find, and edit a stored form with ownership and version lineage

statement.want: to publish an immutable version and share its hosted link
statement.why: respondents need one stable version to complete
statement.done: publish returns a version and share URL without changing prior versions

statement.want: to publish changes without moving active responses to a different version
statement.why: the submitted and signed content must remain stable
statement.done: the owner sees immutable versions and can retire a version intentionally while active work stays pinned

statement.want: to find, inspect, and export collected responses
statement.why: the collected information must be usable outside raw storage
statement.done: the owner can view a response queue and request CSV, JSON, or response detail output

statement.want: a confirmation that points to the receipt
statement.why: people should not have to poll the dashboard or wonder whether intake succeeded
statement.done: the owner can request a deduplicated receipt email without embedding sensitive response content

statement.want: a clear result and a path to the receipt after submit
statement.why: the final step must confirm what happened without hiding proof state
statement.done: the post-submit view says the response was received and keeps the receipt reachable

statement.want: a stable PDF of the form or completed response
statement.why: portable filing and review still depend on fixed output
statement.done: the product offers form and response PDF actions tied to the exact version and response

statement.who: a respondent using a phone, keyboard, screen reader, or zoom
statement.want: to complete the public form without layout or control barriers
statement.why: public intake must work for the people it serves
statement.done: the public form uses labelled fields, clear controls, and narrow-screen-safe layout

statement.want: clear validation and a review step before submit
statement.why: errors and signature disclosures must be visible before commitment
statement.done: the respondent can correct fields, review answers, and choose the next action

statement.want: a receipt that shows what proof exists now
statement.why: a thank-you screen cannot settle a disputed submission
statement.done: the receipt distinguishes accepted, proof pending, proof ready, and proof failed and gives verification instructions when ready

statement.want: to make a response optionally require an attestation tied to its content
statement.why: a serious signature must bind intent to the response digest
statement.done: the owner can select signature mode and the signer can read the exact attestation

statement.want: to create an envelope and give a signer the right content
statement.why: signature work is an operational flow, not only a cryptographic primitive
statement.done: the coordinator can create an envelope and open the signer path for the preserved content

statement.want: to see signer state and request a reminder
statement.why: an invisible stalled envelope cannot be managed
statement.done: the signature view reports envelope state and exposes a reminder action

statement.want: a certificate that survives outside the live app
statement.why: signature proof must preserve attribution, digest, disclosures, and verification instructions
statement.done: the verification view reports certificate availability and offers the certificate only when materialized

statement.want: to verify that the response still matches the submitted bytes
statement.why: mutable dashboard state is not proof against tampering
statement.done: the verifier view reports canonical hashes, checkpoint references, verifier output, or the exact missing proof step

needs.title: Know whether the cell can accept work

statement.want: readiness signals for the active ManagedSingleCell dependencies
statement.why: a green process alone does not prove intake can work
statement.done: the readiness view shows each returned component status and adapter detail without upgrading test health into a production claim

statement.want: to load a version-pinned hosted form through the runtime endpoint or embed snippet
statement.why: published forms need a predictable distribution path outside the owner dashboard
statement.done: the published runtime returns the Definition, theme, locale, runtime settings, cache behavior, and stable embed reference

config.emptyMessage: No managed forms are available from the active cell.

config.title: Choose the next form task
config.body: Actions use the active host; this bundle contains no form fixtures.

config.title: Form draft
config.body: These facts come from the stored draft. Publishing creates the immutable public runtime.

config.title: Published version
config.body: Retiring a version does not rewrite responses or signature envelopes already pinned to it.

config.caption: Responses from the active cell

config.title: Inspect or export
config.body: Exports come from host actions and never from invented widget rows.

config.title: Accepted response
config.body: Accepted intake and verifier-backed proof are separate states.

config.title: Responses available for signature
config.body: Create an envelope only for a response that exposes a signed payload digest.

config.title: Active cell readiness
config.body: These values describe the active profile and adapters. They do not certify a production deployment, backup, or restore.

config.title: Check your response
config.body: Submit now or review the optional signature statement. No signature is implied by this review page.

config.lead: Read this statement before the host asks you to sign.
config.statement: I confirm that the response I reviewed is accurate and that this signature applies to that exact response digest.

config.title: Signature certificate

config.title: Keep or verify this receipt
config.body: Received does not mean independently verified. The proof state returned by the receipt service controls that claim.

entries.name: x-formspec-starter
entries.description: Generic starter widgets for structured forms, queues, receipts, and ceremonies.

entries.name: x-structured-panel
entries.description: Generic structured facts, tables, progress, and mapped actions.

entries.name: x-queue-table
entries.description: Generic accessible queue table with stable row identity and one Need-traced row action.

config.caption: Managed forms
config.emptyMessage: No managed forms are available from the active cell.

config.title: Choose the next form task
config.body: Actions use the active host; this bundle contains no form fixtures.

config.title: Signature work
config.body: Open the signature queue returned by the active host.

config.title: Form draft
config.body: These facts come from the stored draft. Publishing creates the immutable public runtime.

config.title: Published version
config.body: Retiring a version does not rewrite responses or signature envelopes already pinned to it.

config.caption: Responses from the active cell
config.emptyMessage: No accepted responses are available from the active cell.

config.title: Inspect or export
config.body: Exports come from host actions and never from invented widget rows.

config.title: Accepted response
config.body: Accepted intake and verifier-backed proof are separate states.

config.title: Responses available for signature
config.body: Create an envelope only for a response that exposes a signed payload digest.

config.title: Active cell readiness
config.body: These values describe the active profile and adapters. They do not certify a production deployment, backup, or restore.

config.title: Check your response
config.body: Submit now or review the optional signature statement. No signature is implied by this review page.

config.lead: Read this statement before the host asks you to sign.
config.statement: I confirm that the response I reviewed is accurate and that this signature applies to that exact response digest.
config.acknowledgement: The host records the signing act; this frame only shows the statement.

config.title: Complete the host signing step
config.body: Completion is accepted separately from certificate materialization.

config.title: Signature certificate
config.body: Availability and verification claims come from the certificate service.

config.title: Keep or verify this receipt
config.body: Received does not mean independently verified. The proof state returned by the receipt service controls that claim.

config.title: Proof returned by the verifier path
config.body: This view reports stored proof material and missing steps; it does not infer proof from dashboard status.

config.title: Form draft
config.body: These facts come from the stored draft. Publishing creates the immutable public runtime.

config.title: Published version
config.body: Retiring a version does not rewrite responses or signature envelopes already pinned to it.

config.body: Exports come from host actions and never from invented widget rows.

config.title: Accepted response
config.body: Accepted intake and verifier-backed proof are separate states.

config.title: Responses available for signature
config.body: Create an envelope only for a response that exposes a signed payload digest.

config.title: Active cell readiness
config.body: These values describe the active profile and adapters. They do not certify a production deployment, backup, or restore.

config.title: Check your response
config.body: Submit now or review the optional signature statement. No signature is implied by this review page.

config.lead: Read this statement before the host asks you to sign.
config.statement: I confirm that the response I reviewed is accurate and that this signature applies to that exact response digest.
config.acknowledgement: The host records the signing act; this frame only shows the statement.

config.title: Complete the host signing step
config.body: Completion is accepted separately from certificate materialization.

config.title: Signature certificate
config.body: Availability and verification claims come from the certificate service.

config.title: Keep or verify this receipt

config.title: Proof returned by the verifier path
config.body: This view reports stored proof material and missing steps; it does not infer proof from dashboard status.

actors.title: Form owner
actors.description: Creates, publishes, and reviews managed forms and responses.

actors.title: Respondent
actors.description: Completes, reviews, and submits a public response.

actors.title: Signature coordinator
actors.description: Creates envelopes and follows signer progress.

actors.title: Signer
actors.description: Reads the attestation and completes the signature ceremony.

actors.title: Verifier
actors.description: Checks receipt and certificate proof independently.

actors.title: Cell operator
actors.description: Checks the active cell and remediates failed proof work.

actors.title: Integrator
actors.description: Uses the published runtime endpoint and embed snippet.
